title: Rave Finder input
description: Find upcoming techno, house, and drum & bass events near a Czech city.

city.title: City
city.description: Czech city to search near, e.g. "Brno".

radiusKm.title: Radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Maximum distance from the city center to include events, in kilometers.

genres.title: Genres
genres.description: Electronic music genres to include. "Electronic (general)" covers events that are clearly electronic/DJ music but don't name a specific genre in their own listing (e.g. a branded party or festival satellite event) — kept when the source itself is dedicated to electronic music.

dateRangeDays.title: Date range (days)
dateRangeDays.description: Only include events happening within this many days from now.

includeFacebookEvents.title: Include Facebook Events
includeFacebookEvents.description: Search Facebook Events in addition to the other sources (uses the apify/facebook-events-scraper Actor, ~$0.013/event). Off by default: Facebook's event search OR-matches rather than filtering, so it reliably returns either global genre matches or every unrelated event in the town, and in live testing it surfaced no electronic events for the searched region while consuming most of the run's time and budget. Turn it on if you want to try it for a bigger city.

maxFacebookEvents.title: Max Facebook events
maxFacebookEvents.description: Caps how many Facebook events are fetched, to control cost (apify/facebook-events-scraper runs at roughly $0.013 per event). Kept low: Facebook's event search OR-matches, so a query like "drum and bass Havířov" also returns every unrelated event in that town — yoga classes, board-game nights — each of which costs the same per-event fee before this Actor's genre filter discards it.

maxMapsVenues.title: Max Maps-discovered venues per search term
maxMapsVenues.description: Discovers club-like venues near the city via Google Maps (compass/crawler-google-places, ~$1.50 per 1,000 places), so cities outside the curated seed list still get coverage. Caps results per search term; set to 0 to disable this source entirely. Kept low by default: each discovered venue costs an Actor call to crawl, and in practice most results are dance schools, restaurants and bars rather than electronic venues.

subscriberEmail.title: Subscriber email (optional)
subscriberEmail.description: If set, a periodic email digest of newly found matching events is sent to this address via Resend.

digestFrequency.title: Digest frequency
digestFrequency.description: How often to send the email digest. The Actor can run more often than this (e.g. on a daily schedule) — it will only actually send once enough time has passed since the last send.

resendApiKey.title: Resend API key (optional)
resendApiKey.description: Required only if subscriberEmail is set. Get one at resend.com. Pass this as a secret input, never commit it.
